## Checklist

- [ ] The teardown lives in `teardowns/<subject-slug>/` with the expected files
      (`teardown.html`, `design-tokens.css`, `tokens.json`, the design docs, and `assets/`).
- [ ] The gallery index has been regenerated so the new teardown is listed.
- [ ] `teardown.html` opens correctly directly from disk via `file://`, with no
      server, no build step, and no network access.
- [ ] No commercial fonts, video, audio, or proprietary source were added. Any
      such asset is described by manifest and linked to its original source
      instead of being committed.
- [ ] The license of any added material is declared (code under MIT, original
      content under CC BY 4.0, and any third-party material named with its source
      and license).
- [ ] Screenshots of the teardown page are attached below.
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) per the Developer Certificate of Origin.
